display_long_description:
# SMALL TRUCKS. BIG SORTING CHALLENGES

Turn a miniature cargo yard into your next VR puzzle obsession. Cargo Loop: Color Sort Puzzle brings colorful parcels, moving conveyors and little trucks to a tabletop in front of you.

# MATCH COLORS. MASTER THE ORDER

Point at a truck to release its next cargo group. Match parcels with the right trucks and plan your sequence carefully. Belt space is limited: send the wrong colors too soon and you could bring everything to a halt.

# 75 LEVELS TO KEEP YOU THINKING

Work through different conveyor shapes and cargo arrangements. Read the board, decide what should move first and enjoy the moment a crowded level finally clears.

# A LITTLE WORLD WITH BIG SATISFACTION

Lean closer to inspect your miniature yard. Watch parcels travel, trucks fill and deliveries roll away. Simple controller selection keeps your attention on the puzzle.

# SETTLE IN AND SORT

Play seated or standing, with adjustable table height to suit your position. Step into the harbor room for a quick puzzle break or work through your next run of levels.

•	**Color-matching puzzles with limited conveyor space**

•	**75 levels with varied layouts**

•	**Miniature trucks and automatic cargo movement**

•	**Controller-based point-and-select interaction**

•	**Seated and standing play**

**Can you clear the cargo without creating a jam?**
